estimand: weighted functional covariance and reconstruction of raw VAS in interval-complete candidate subjects
scale: VAS 0-10; no subject standardization; trapezoidal time weights
bootstrap_unit: whole subject row pending identity verification
cv_target: full held-out curve projection on training mean/basis, not future or missing-value prediction
stability: rank-ordered leading-k subspace maximum principal angle for each k; matched axis inner products are supplementary
bootstrap_summary: median and 2.5/97.5 empirical percentiles, descriptive stability ranges not calibrated confidence intervals
dimension_policy: report all k and 90% sample FVE crossing; no automatic selection or clinical phenotype labels
limits: complete-case selection unresolved; not sparse PACE; reconstruction errors use the entire held-out curve for scoring; no inferential p-values
